# GENERATED by tools/gen_space_race.py - edit the generator, not this file.

# Prestige for a space milestone. 1st: big, 4th: a small loss.
wif_sat_prestige_major = {
	add_to_variable = { wif_gp_bonus_score = 50 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = 15 }
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_cred min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	else = {
		add_political_power = 150
		add_war_support = 0.05
	}
}

wif_sat_prestige_loss = {
	add_to_variable = { wif_gp_bonus_score = -10 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = -5 }
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_cred min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	else = {
		add_political_power = -50
	}
}

# Unmanned Prototype finished: the first is the first satellite in space.
wif_sat_prototype_race = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_sat_first_in_space } }
		set_global_flag = wif_sat_first_in_space
		set_variable = { global.wif_sat_n1 = THIS }
		news_event = { id = wif_sat.1 days = 1 }
		wif_sat_prestige_major = yes
	}
	log = "WiF SAT: [This.GetName] completed the Unmanned Prototype"
}

# Radio Satellites finished: 1st big prestige, 2nd/3rd nothing, 4th a loss.
wif_sat_radio_race = {
	add_to_variable = { global.wif_sat_radio_rank = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.wif_sat_radio_rank = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.wif_sat_n2 = THIS }
		news_event = { id = wif_sat.2 days = 1 }
		wif_sat_prestige_major = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.wif_sat_radio_rank = 4 } }
		wif_sat_prestige_loss = yes
	}
	log = "WiF SAT: [This.GetName] completed Radio Satellites (rank [?global.wif_sat_radio_rank])"
}

# First satellite of this country reaches orbit.
wif_sat_launch_race = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_sat_launched } }
		set_country_flag = wif_sat_launched
		add_to_variable = { global.wif_sat_launch_rank = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.wif_sat_launch_rank = 1 } }
			set_variable = { global.wif_sat_n3 = THIS }
			news_event = { id = wif_sat.3 days = 1 }
			wif_sat_prestige_major = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.wif_sat_launch_rank = 4 } }
			wif_sat_prestige_loss = yes
		}
	}
}

# Monthly, country scope: count Space Port levels we hold, lose satellites we
# can no longer control, keep the coverage spirit in step.
wif_sat_monthly = {
	set_variable = { wif_sat_ports = 0 }
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			is_controlled_by = PREV
			wif_space_port > 0
		}
		add_to_variable = { PREV.wif_sat_ports = building_level@wif_space_port }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_sat_orbit > wif_sat_ports } }
		set_variable = { wif_sat_orbit = wif_sat_ports }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { wif_sat_orbit > 0 }
			NOT = { has_idea = wif_sat_coverage_idea }
		}
		add_ideas = wif_sat_coverage_idea
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { wif_sat_orbit < 1 }
			has_idea = wif_sat_coverage_idea
		}
		remove_ideas = wif_sat_coverage_idea
	}
}
